name: kde-wayland-suite
description: Comprehensive KDE Plasma 6 Wayland configuration plugin: fixes for system-wide Ctrl+<key> breakage (kxkbrc keymap-compile race, the fcitx5 keyboard grab, and Tongfang/Avell i8042/ACPI matrix drop), cedilla on US-intl via the native pt_BR compose table (LC_CTYPE, no input method), Wayland clipboard repair (wl-clipboard/xsel deadlock), 3/4-finger touchpad gestures via libinput-gestures and KWin D-Bus, Logitech MX Master 3S via logiops, and battery/power diagnostics (hybrid GPU primary, PCIe ASPM, PCI runtime PM).
author: Renan BS
